title: Trumpet
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- bell -->
    <path d="M70 28 Q88 30 90 50 Q88 70 70 72 L64 66 Q76 62 78 50 Q76 38 64 34 Z" fill="#ffd24a"/>
    <path d="M70 28 Q88 30 90 50 Q88 70 70 72 L64 66 Q76 62 78 50 Q76 38 64 34 Z" fill="none" stroke="#fff0a8" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="89" cy="50" rx="3" ry="13" fill="#ffe89a"/>
    <!-- bell rim -->
    <ellipse cx="89" cy="50" rx="3" ry="13" fill="none" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <!-- main tube -->
    <rect x="24" y="44" width="42" height="12" rx="3" fill="#ffb52e"/>
    <rect x="24" y="44" width="42" height="4" rx="2" fill="#ffd88a"/>
    <rect x="24" y="52" width="42" height="4" rx="2" fill="#e08f14"/>
    <!-- valve casing -->
    <rect x="36" y="22" width="5" height="24" rx="2" fill="#ffe89a"/>
    <rect x="46" y="22" width="5" height="24" rx="2" fill="#ffe89a"/>
    <rect x="56" y="22" width="5" height="24" rx="2" fill="#ffe89a"/>
    <!-- valve caps -->
    <circle cx="38.5" cy="22" r="3.2" fill="#fff4c8"/>
    <circle cx="48.5" cy="22" r="3.2" fill="#fff4c8"/>
    <circle cx="58.5" cy="22" r="3.2" fill="#fff4c8"/>
    <!-- valve stems/buttons -->
    <rect x="37" y="16" width="3" height="4" rx="1" fill="#ffffff"/>
    <rect x="47" y="16" width="3" height="4" rx="1" fill="#ffffff"/>
    <rect x="57" y="16" width="3" height="4" rx="1" fill="#ffffff"/>
    <!-- valve ring details -->
    <rect x="35.5" y="40" width="6" height="2" rx="1" fill="#ffffff"/>
    <rect x="45.5" y="40" width="6" height="2" rx="1" fill="#ffffff"/>
    <rect x="55.5" y="40" width="6" height="2" rx="1" fill="#ffffff"/>
    <!-- mouthpiece -->
    <rect x="10" y="46" width="12" height="8" rx="2" fill="#ffd24a"/>
    <rect x="10" y="46" width="12" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#ffe89a"/>
    <rect x="4" y="47.5" width="7" height="5" rx="1.5" fill="#fff4c8"/>
    <!-- mouthpiece cup -->
    <ellipse cx="5" cy="50" rx="2.5" ry="4" fill="#ffe89a"/>
    <!-- water key / loop -->
    <path d="M60 56 Q64 64 56 64 Q50 64 50 56" fill="none" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- finger hook -->
    <path d="M30 40 Q26 38 28 32 Q30 28 34 30" fill="none" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>
</svg>
